visual.title: Same spread, different distributions
visual.caption: All three densities here have standard deviation 1. Move x and compare the shaded tail with the other two: the same interval gets a different probability from each family.

predict.question: At x = 1, which family puts the most probability below that point?
predict.explain: The normal accumulates fastest near its centre, giving about 0.84, against 0.79 for the uniform and 0.63 for the exponential.
